whatIsIt.eli5: The map is cut into a few strips; inside each strip, every spot looks at every other spot.
whatIsIt.simple: Self-attention where the positions are first split into `area` equal groups (strips), and attention runs only inside each group. A 7×7 depthwise conv adds position information.
whatIsIt.engineer: qkv = Conv1×1(dim→3·dim); reshape to (B·area, N/area, ·); softmax(qᵀk/√d)·v per head; + PE (DW7×7 on v); proj Conv1×1.

whyExists.eli5: Looking everywhere is costly; strips keep most of the benefit for much less work.
whyExists.simple: Splitting into l areas cuts the attention cost by about l times while each area is still large, so the field of view stays big.
whyExists.engineer: Cost O(N²d/l) vs O(N²d); simple reshape, no window shifting (paper §3.2).

eli5: Inside each strip, spots compare with each other.
Each spot gathers notes from good matches.
simple: 1×1 Conv makes queries, keys and values.
Attention scores and mixing happen inside each strip.
A 7×7 depthwise conv on the values adds a sense of position (no positional encoding needed).
engineer: YOLOv13's fork uses an older AAttn: separate qk and v convs and a 5×5 positional conv.
